description: 两张比较事件的严格参数/权威输入形状与手写期望有限算术；真实来源鉴权、随机事务、持久化收据和保存恢复另列planned。
expected_values_policy: Expectations were independently hand-derived from verified card/rules sources. Twelve map fixtures were independently derived by a read-only agent using the full 84-country map, without the reference resolver.
input_patch_semantics: Merge only context/state/evidence containers one level. Nested maps/arrays replace entirely. country_fixture is a test-only expansion over the explicitly complete zero-map default, never a runtime sparse-map default.
fixture_boundary: All authorization/evidence labels are synthetic internal prerequisites, not authentication tests. Digest placeholders are filled only by fixture construction before the frozen request enters the pure model. Fixed dice are test-provider inputs outside the request.
digest_policy: Original request SHA256 uses sorted compact UTF-8 JSON of context/state/evidence, excluding context.original_request_digest and transport command_id. Receipt SHA256 uses every receipt field except receipt_digest. Digests bind contents, do not authenticate clients.

cases.note: Synthetic authorized-role fixture, not authorization for any named external source.

runtime_cases.description: 真实会话鉴权、来源授权、根/子帧生命周期，拒绝未注册外部来源。
异常注入验证初始双骰/VP/RNG/收据/选择事务共同提交或共同回滚。
同Resolution原请求只返既有收据，同ID不同摘要拒绝，不按后来地图重算。
非法或异常DEFCON回应保留已提交骰/VP，无第二次RNG或奖励。
等待胜者选择时真实序列化恢复，保留两骰、角色、摘要、VP批次与Revision。
VP终局不创DEFCON选择，核战终局与Finished吸收停止父流程。
统一非星号去向、事件完成/父帧收据仅一次，不提前处理等待中的Summit。
玩家视图不暴露未结算头条、手牌、随机源状态或内部授权凭据。
真实完整84国快照、绑定版本和所有相关策略提供者，与生产控制查询一致。
已核实独立规则中断后恢复原竞赛收据，现行DEFCON和来源继续位置再校验。
C#整数上下界与checked溢出故障回滚，无静默钳制或部分提交。
断线重投与并发旧版本回应使用真实命令去重和版本锁，非布尔模拟。
